## Contracts, consumers, and exclusions
Preserve registry-as-routing-authority, help/overview/unknown pre-scan before configuration or effects, global override precedence, exactly one bound operation snapshot, store-mount exclusions and ordering, and all stdout/stderr/exit-code shapes. Preserve automatic attachment versus explicit first-store consent, configured tracker-root resolution, and best-effort mount boundaries. Preserve Jira configuration precedence and presence-only secret handling. Preserve LLM admission/source error classes, retryable versus judgement exits, signing/sidecar persistence, retry eligibility, reuse notation, and uncapped-result disclosure. Preserve parser InvalidInputError ownership and the registry's closed capability/adapter/init vocabularies, aliases, lazy handlers, policy sets, and deterministic lookup. Consumers are CLI users and scripts plus library/MCP lifecycle adapters and generated help/reference parity tests. No allowlisted docstring feeds argparse help; all committed help bytes and runtime error/help strings remain exact.

Concise or load-bearing prose outside the allowlist stays byte-identical. So do every runtime string, assertion, fixture, decorator, command argument, config key/value, and physical directive/shebang line. Repository-wide __doc__/inspect.getdoc census found no programmatic consumer of an allowlisted docstring.

## Verification and independent review
Compare each final file to d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84. For Python, parse with type_comments=True, replace only leading docstrings owned by the allowlisted Module/ClassDef/FunctionDef/AsyncFunctionDef owners, normalize only ast.TypeIgnore.lineno, and require the remaining AST/runtime tree to match. A zero-context diff-hunk guard permits changes only inside the cited base spans; directive/shebang physical lines must match exactly. Run the structured focused, path, hygiene, diff, and untimed repository commands.

A reviewer who did not author the patch records a leaf-linked TSV with one PASS row per edited block (65 total): stable_id, before_citation, final_citation, preserved_contract_or_consumer, directives_exact, before_words, final_words, reviewer_session, semantic_pass, bloat_pass. Every final_words value must be smaller; missing, extra, or FAIL rows block closure.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Exactly the 65 allowlisted blocks are shortened; no other prose or directive changes.
- [ ] The immutable-base prose-only oracle passes for all 8 files.
- [ ] Every preserved contract above has a concrete independent-review PASS citation.
- [ ] HEAD^..HEAD changes exactly the declared paths; focused checks, diff-check, hygiene, and make verify exit 0.
- [ ] The independent TSV has exactly 65 complete PASS rows and proves a word-count reduction per block.
